context_and_flow.ux_intent: Confirm to the user that a magic login link has been sent and provide an option to resend if not received.
ux_patterns: The hero illustration is a 3D-style magic wand with sparkling stars, serving as a metaphorical representation of a 'magic link'.
The illustration is placed centrally between the header and the instructional text.
Visual hierarchy is clear with the 'Log in' title at the top and actionable text at the bottom.
The design uses a soft, friendly aesthetic with gradients on the wand icon.
